messages.content: "compersion" word ta ki mane, kothaw dekhlam kintu bujhini

Compersion, in short, is the opposite of jealousy - feeling genuine happiness when your partner experiences joy with someone else, most commonly discussed in ethical non-monogamy contexts. Eta jealousy er absence na, eta ekta positive feeling jeta jealousy er sathe ekসাথেও thakte pare - kono somoy dujon e ekসাথে.
